visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A wide shot of a dark stadium filled with thousands of blue light sticks. A large LED screen in the center displays the text 'THIS IS FOR'. (2) A title card appears over the stadium background, displaying images of three smartphone backs (iPhone, Galaxy, vivo) and text listing their models. (3) The scene cuts to a brightly lit stage where three female performers in white and black costumes are dancing energetically. The footage is labeled as iPhone 17 Pro Max. (4) The scene shifts to another angle of the same performance, now labeled Galaxy S25 Ultra; the lighting is slightly cooler. (5) Footage of a group of female performers dancing is shown, labeled vivo X300 Pro. A text overlay switches between 'Normal Mode' and 'Stage Mode', showing a significant increase in clarity and color saturation in the latter. (6) A split-screen comparison appears with iPhone 17 Pro Max (24x) on top and Galaxy S25 Ultra (20x) on bottom, showing female performers in blue outfits performing synchronized choreography. (7) Another split-screen shows Galaxy S25 Ultra (20x) vs. vivo X300 Pro (20x), featuring performers dancing around horizontal metal bars. (8) A three-way vertical split screen compares all three phones simultaneously, showing the same stage moment. Interaction text overlays appear at the bottom. (9) The video ends with a plain black screen featuring centered yellow text.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comparative showcase of the zooming and low-light 'Stage Mode' capabilities of three high-end smartphones (iPhone 17 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, and vivo X300 Pro) using a live concert as the test environment. It aims to engage tech-savvy viewers and concert-goers to determine which device performs best under challenging stage lighting conditions.
